Virgo nature

Virgo is traditionally the sign of service, precision and practical intelligence. Ruled by Mercury like Gemini, it turns that quick mind towards detail: analysing, organising and improving. Virgo is associated with modesty, reliability and genuine helpfulness; it is also said to be its own harshest critic, and to worry over things that are already good enough.

Virgo in love and work

In love Virgo is associated with showing care through practical acts rather than words. At work it is linked with health, accounting, research, editing and any field where accuracy matters.

Which sign is mine?

In India, "your rashi" usually means your Vedic Moon sign, which needs your birth time and is often different from the Western sun sign you get from your birthday alone. If you are not sure which you are, the free calculators will tell you both.

Frequently asked

Common questions

Is Virgo the same as Kanya rashi?

Yes — Kanya is the Hindi name for the same sign. What can differ is how you work out which sign is yours: by your Western sun sign (23 August – 22 September) or by your Vedic Moon sign, which needs your birth time.

Which planet rules Virgo?

Mercury. That is why Wednesday, the day of Mercury, is traditionally considered Virgo's day, and why remedies for the sign often involve Mercury.

Which signs are traditionally compatible with Virgo?

Taurus, Capricorn, Pisces are the traditional pairings: the other signs of its element, and the seventh sign, the house of partnership. Real compatibility is judged from two full birth charts through kundli matching, not from signs alone.
